record.question: The song had a soporific effect on the child
record.explanation: Answer C: sleep-inducing. Soporific describes something that induces sleep; “sleep-inducing” is the direct synonym. Being sad or frightening does not express this meaning. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/soporific. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
